purpose: Read-only drawing brief from existing baseline gameplay. Not a runtime manifest and not authorization to alter collisions.

coordinate_contract.right_point_to_source: source.x = pivot.x + world_offset.x / candidate_scale; source.y = pivot.y + world_offset.y / candidate_scale
coordinate_contract.right_box_to_source: source.xy = pivot.xy + world_relative_box.xy / candidate_scale; source.wh = world_relative_box.wh / candidate_scale
coordinate_contract.left_mirroring: For an offset point, x_left=-x_right. For a rectangle, x_left=-(x_right+w); y,w,h unchanged. Runtime mirrors the right-facing drawing.
coordinate_contract.airborne_anchor: The anchor moves with the actual airborne fighter; listed boxes remain relative to that anchor.
coordinate_contract.standing_height: All nine active attacks currently use standing body height, including Sweep: fighter.crouching requires attack.is_none(). Do not lower a hitbox to match a drawing.
coordinate_contract.projectile_origin: Manifest point is the near horizontal projectile edge and its vertical center, not the projectile rectangle center. Align emitting hand/muzzle with the point; projectile sprite stays separate.
coordinate_contract.precision: Baseline local origin/pivot and full JSON scale are preserved, plus derived world offsets without decimal rounding; source coordinates are calculated only after candidate scale/pivot are measured.

rules: Use contact coordinates to place drawn active fists/feet, not to author new combat metadata.
Preserve every existing special origin in its original baseline manifest; presentation atlas must not replace the combat manifest.
All five special specs emit at tick0. First drawing already emits; later drawings recover. Cooldown is not animation duration.
Do not put permanent projectile, opponent, debug boxes, guide arrows, or guide circles into the fighter drawing.
Keep source rectangles large enough for raised hands, extended feet, accessories, and vapor; never trim to an assumed fixed cell.
New raster generation uses solid #FF00FF background; inspect processed alpha on dark and light backgrounds.
Jump art proposal60/340/300/100ms follows approximately0.8s flight with apex near0.4s; physics and landing remain unchanged.
